places.name: Cerro Catedral Ski Resort
places.ai_summary: Largest ski resort in the Southern Hemisphere, offering extensive slopes for skiing and snowboarding in winter (June-Oct). In summer, offers hiking, mountain biking, and gondola rides for panoramic views of Nahuel Huapi Lake and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.mon: Varies seasonally (Ski lifts/Summer activities, check website)
opening_hours.notes: Check official website for specific season dates and lift/activity hours

places.suggested_duration: Half-day to Full-day (or multi-day for skiing)
places.place_tip: Book ski passes/lessons/rentals in advance during winter. Check lift status for summer activities. Can get very crowded during peak ski season (July/Aug). Base village offers accommodation and dining.
places.address: Cerro Catedral Base, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Civic Center & Lake Nahuel Huapi
places.ai_summary: Bariloche's main square (Centro Cívico) features distinctive alpine-style stone and wood architecture. Offers views of Nahuel Huapi Lake, houses government buildings, the Patagonia Museum, and often hosts events. The adjacent lakefront is popular for strolls.

opening_hours.notes: Public square; check Patagonia Museum hours

places.place_tip: Iconic photo spot with St. Bernard dogs (pay for photos). Visit the Patagonia Museum for regional history. Enjoy the lake views. Can be busy, especially in peak season.
places.address: Centro Cívico, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Circuito Chico Scenic Drive
places.ai_summary: A popular short scenic loop drive (~60km) starting from Bariloche. Follows the shore of Nahuel Huapi and Moreno lakes, passing forests, viewpoints (like Cerro Campanario), Llao Llao Hotel, and trailheads. Can be done by car, bike, or tour bus.

opening_hours.notes: Public road; attractions along route have own hours

places.place_tip: Allow ample time for photo stops. Stop at Cerro Campanario for arguably the best views. Consider a detour to Colonia Suiza (especially on market days). Renting a car offers flexibility.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for drive; recommended for chairlifts/activities
places.address: Circuito Chico (Route Provincial 77), Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Cerro Campanario Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: Accessible via chairlift or a steep hike, Cerro Campanario offers arguably the most breathtaking 360-degree panoramic views in the Bariloche area, overlooking Nahuel Huapi and Moreno lakes, surrounding mountains, and the Llao Llao Peninsula. Cafe at the top.

opening_hours.notes: Chairlift hours; may vary seasonally or with weather, last ascent usually ~17:30

places.place_tip: Located along the Circuito Chico route (Km 17.5). Chairlift is the easiest way up. Allow time to savor the views from the multiple platforms. Cafe can be busy.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for chairlift (pay on site)
places.address: Av. Exequiel Bustillo Km 17.5, R8400 San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Nahuel Huapi National Park
places.ai_summary: Argentina's oldest national park, surrounding Nahuel Huapi Lake and encompassing Bariloche itself. Offers vast landscapes of lakes, forests, and mountains. Activities include hiking, boating, kayaking, fishing, scenic drives (like Circuito Chico and Seven Lakes Route).

opening_hours.mon: Park open 24/7; specific areas/trails may have seasonal closures/hours
opening_hours.notes: Check official park website for trail status, fees, and regulations

places.best_time_to_visit: Summer (Dec-Mar) for hiking/boating; Autumn (Apr-May) for colors; Winter (Jun-Sep) for snow activities
places.place_tip: Obtain park maps and check trail conditions before hiking. Be prepared for changeable weather. Entrance fees may apply in certain sectors.
places.advanced_booking: Required for some refugios (mountain huts) or specific guided activities
places.address: Nahuel Huapi National Park, Río Negro & Neuquén Provinces, Argentina

places.name: Isla Victoria & Arrayanes Forest Boat Tour
places.ai_summary: Classic boat excursion on Nahuel Huapi Lake from Puerto Pañuelo. Visits Isla Victoria with hiking trails and scenic views, and the Quetrihué Peninsula, home to a unique forest of cinnamon-colored Arrayán trees.

opening_hours.notes: Multiple departures daily, check schedules

places.place_tip: Book in advance, especially during peak season. Bring layers as it can be windy on the lake. Wear comfortable shoes for walking on the island and peninsula.
places.name_english: Victoria Island & Arrayanes Forest Boat Tour
places.cost: Paid (Boat tour + National Park fee + Port tax)
places.address: Departs from Puerto Pañuelo (Av. Bustillo Km 25), Llao Llao, Bariloche
places.name_native: Excursión Isla Victoria y Bosque de Arrayanes

places.name: Colonia Suiza Village
places.ai_summary: Small village near Bariloche founded by Swiss immigrants. Known for its artisan market (esp. Wednesdays and Sundays), traditional 'curanto' food preparation (cooked underground with hot stones), and Alpine-style architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Market days (Wed/Sun) are busiest; curanto served around midday

places.best_time_to_visit: Wednesdays or Sundays for the market and curanto
places.place_tip: Located off the Circuito Chico loop. Arrive around noon on market days to see the curanto preparation and enjoy the food/stalls. Can get crowded.
places.address: Colonia Suiza, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Cerro Otto Cable Car
places.ai_summary: Mountain easily accessible from Bariloche town via cable car (teleférico) or road. Offers panoramic views of the lake and city, a revolving restaurant (Confitería Giratoria), art gallery, and winter activities like sledding.

opening_hours.notes: Cable car hours; last ascent earlier. May close due to wind/weather. Check website.

places.place_tip: Cable car departs from Km 5 on Av. Bustillo (free shuttle often available from downtown). Revolving restaurant offers views but food can be average/pricey. Check weather before going up.
places.advanced_booking: Not usually required for cable car
places.address: Base at Av. de los Pioneros Km 5, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Playa Bonita Beach
places.ai_summary: Popular pebble beach on Nahuel Huapi Lake located about 8km from Bariloche city center along Av. Bustillo. Offers lake access for swimming (cold water!) or sunbathing, cafes, and views across the water.

opening_hours.notes: Public beach access

places.place_tip: Water is very cold year-round. Can get crowded in summer. Easily accessible by bus or car from town.
places.address: Av. Exequiel Bustillo Km 8, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Chocolate Avenue (Mitre Street)
places.ai_summary: Mitre Street, the main commercial street in downtown Bariloche, is famous for its numerous artisanal chocolate shops ('chocolaterías'). Offers free samples and a wide variety of Patagonian chocolates, often featuring local berries and nuts.

opening_hours.notes: Main street accessible 24/7; check individual shop hours

places.place_tip: Many shops offer free samples. Popular brands include Rapa Nui, Mamuschka, Fenoglio, Del Turista. Rapa Nui also has an ice skating rink.
places.address: Calle Mitre, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Llao Llao Hotel & Golf Resort
places.ai_summary: Iconic luxury hotel located on a peninsula between Nahuel Huapi and Moreno lakes, part of the Circuito Chico. Known for its stunning architecture, golf course, spa, and incredible views. Non-guests can visit for afternoon tea or meals (reservations essential).

opening_hours.mon: Hotel operates 24/7; visitor access/dining requires reservation
opening_hours.notes: Check website for dining/afternoon tea reservations for non-guests

places.place_tip: Make reservations well in advance for afternoon tea or dining if not staying at the hotel. Enjoy the architecture and surrounding views. Located at Km 25 of Av. Bustillo.
places.address: Av. Exequiel Bustillo Km. 25, R8401 San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Tronador Mountain & Black Glacier
places.ai_summary: Cerro Tronador is an extinct volcano on the Chile-Argentina border, known for its glaciers that 'thunder' (tronar) as ice falls. Ventisquero Negro (Black Glacier) at its base is unique, originating from white ice higher up but picking up dark sediment.

opening_hours.mon: Park access times vary by season
opening_hours.notes: Requires drive on gravel road (approx 2 hrs from Bariloche); check Nahuel Huapi Park website for access times/road conditions (often one-way schedules)

places.place_tip: Allow ample travel time. The road is unpaved and can be rough. Check the one-way road schedule (usually up in morning, down in afternoon). Guided tours are available. Bring warm layers.
places.advanced_booking: Not required for general access, but park fees apply
places.address: Cerro Tronador access road, Nahuel Huapi National Park, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Seven Lakes Route (Road Trip)
places.ai_summary: Famous scenic drive (Ruta 40) between Villa La Angostura and San Martín de los Andes, north of Bariloche. Passes stunning Patagonian lakes (Nahuel Huapi, Espejo, Correntoso, Escondido, Villarino, Falkner, Machónico) and mountain scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Public road (RN 40); check road status, especially in winter (snow/ice possible)

places.suggested_duration: Full-day (round trip from Bariloche or one way)
places.best_time_to_visit: Summer (Dec-Mar) for best weather; Autumn (Apr-May) for spectacular colors
places.place_tip: Allow ample time for stops at viewpoints ('miradores'). The road is fully paved. Can be done as a day trip from Bariloche or as part of a longer journey north.
places.address: Ruta Nacional 40 (between Villa La Angostura and San Martín de los Andes)

places.name: Kayaking on Lake Moreno
places.ai_summary: Lake Moreno, located along the Circuito Chico, is a popular spot for kayaking due to its calmer waters compared to parts of Nahuel Huapi and its scenic bays and shores. Rentals and guided tours available.

opening_hours.notes: Check specific rental/tour operators; weather dependent

places.place_tip: Several access points along Circuito Chico. Check weather conditions before heading out. Guided tours offer equipment and local knowledge.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended for guided tours/rentals in peak season
places.address: Lago Moreno, Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Puerto Pañuelo Dock
places.ai_summary: Main port located on the Llao Llao Peninsula (Km 25), serving as the departure point for major boat excursions on Nahuel Huapi Lake, including the popular trip to Isla Victoria and the Arrayanes Forest.

opening_hours.notes: Must arrive before scheduled boat departure time

places.place_tip: Located near the Llao Llao Hotel. Arrive early for check-in. Port tax is usually payable here in cash. Parking available.
places.advanced_booking: Required for boat tours departing from here
places.cost: Free (access); port tax required for boat trips
places.address: Av. Exequiel Bustillo Km 25.5, R8401 San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Refugio Frey Hike
places.ai_summary: Popular day hike or overnight trek in Nahuel Huapi National Park to Refugio Frey, a mountain hut situated by Laguna Toncek amidst granite spires. Known for stunning scenery and rock climbing opportunities.

opening_hours.mon: Trail open (weather permitting); Refugio has seasonal operation
opening_hours.notes: Check trail conditions/closures (esp. winter) & Refugio Frey status/booking needs

places.place_tip: Starts from Villa Catedral (Cerro Catedral base). Moderate difficulty hike. Bring water, food, layers. Register hike intention with park authorities. Book Refugio stay well in advance.
places.advanced_booking: Required for overnight stay at Refugio
places.cost: Free (hike); Park fee may apply; Refugio stay paid
places.address: Trailhead at Villa Catedral, Nahuel Huapi National Park, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Bariloche Craft Brewery Tour
places.ai_summary: Bariloche is a major center for craft beer ('cerveza artesanal') in Argentina. Various breweries are located in and around the city, particularly along Av. Bustillo (Km markers). Many offer tours, tastings, and have brewpubs.

opening_hours.notes: Check individual brewery websites for hours, tours, reservations

places.place_tip: Popular breweries include Patagonia (Km 24.7 - great views), Gilbert (Km 24.7), Manush (Km 4 or downtown), Berlina (Km 12 or Colonia Suiza). Consider taxi/remis or bus if tasting.
places.advanced_booking: Recommended for tours, or large groups at brewpubs
places.sunset_time: Possible from breweries with views (e.g., Patagonia)
places.address: Various locations, many along Av. Exequiel Bustillo, Bariloche

places.name: Patagonia Museum
places.ai_summary: Located in the Centro Cívico, this museum covers the natural and human history of Patagonia, including indigenous cultures, exploration, San Martín's crossing, and regional fauna. Housed in one of the iconic civic center buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Hours can be limited and variable; confirm locally before visiting

places.place_tip: Good overview of regional history located conveniently in the town center. Check current opening times carefully.
places.address: Centro Cívico, San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Campanario Hill Chairlift
places.ai_summary: Chairlift ('aerosilla') ascending Cerro Campanario, providing access to renowned panoramic viewpoints over the surrounding lakes and mountains. A key stop on the Circuito Chico scenic drive.

opening_hours.notes: May vary seasonally or with weather, last ascent typically ~17:30

places.place_tip: Offers some of the best views in Bariloche. Located at Km 17.5 on Circuito Chico. Cafe available at the top.
places.address: Av. Exequiel Bustillo Km 17.5, R8400 San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina

places.name: Llao Llao Peninsula Trail
places.ai_summary: Easy, scenic walking trail within the Llao Llao Municipal Park, located near the famous hotel. Offers walks through native forests (Coihue, Arrayán) with viewpoints overlooking Lake Moreno and Nahuel Huapi Lake.

opening_hours.notes: Public park trails

places.place_tip: Several interconnected trails allow for shorter or longer walks. Wear comfortable walking shoes. Can be combined with a visit to Puerto Pañuelo or views of the Llao Llao Hotel.
places.address: Parque Municipal Llao Llao, Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina (access near Km 25 of Av. Bustillo)
